summary: Iteration 79 consolidation regression PASSED. Followed real navigation (login → Profile → 'Accessibility Settings' button) and confirmed router.push('/settings?anchor=accessibility') lands on Settings with the Accessibility heading scrolled to the top of the viewport. Both George and Georgia chips render on the George's Voice card; selecting Georgia persists to AsyncStorage (@friendplace/george_voice=georgia) across a full page reload; the auto-preview immediately after selection fires POST /api/mcgs/george/speak with body {voice:'georgia'} — confirming the pref flows through to every SpeakerButton path. All new toggles present and clickable (toggle-simplified, toggle-read-aloud, toggle-auto-read, toggle-voice-input). Favourite thoughts sheet opens with the exact empty-state copy required. /settings/accessibility direct URL renders the Expo '+not-found' Unmatched Route screen (deleted route confirmed). /settings without an anchor opens with scrollY=0 (no jump). Website /admin/dashboard returns HTTP 404 (folder deleted), /admin/bridge still 200. Voice pref reset to 'george' at end. WEBSITE Add-admin invite-modal noValidate polish was NOT exercised via UI this pass — see caveat below.
action_items: Optional: Consider adding testID='settings-accessibility-heading' to the Accessibility <Text> in /app/frontend/app/settings.tsx so future regression scripts can assert the scroll position programmatically rather than by screenshot inspection.

Not tested in this iteration: the noValidate/custom-error polish on the Mission Control Add-admin modal (/admin/account). The code inspection in /app/website/app/admin/account/page.tsx shows the form uses `noValidate` and does an empty-displayName check with the exact copy 'Please give this admin a display name so they don't show up as just "Admin".' plus the email regex check with 'Please enter a valid email address.' — matches spec. Recommend a follow-up manual smoke or a Playwright pass against localhost:3001/admin/account to visually confirm the browser tooltip is suppressed.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx is now 569 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. The GeorgeVoiceCard sub-component and the FavouriteThoughts modal could be extracted into their own files next iteration to keep this file focused on the top-level Settings shell.

Old /settings/accessibility route falls through to Expo's default 404 screen which is functionally correct but visually stark (black background, 'Unmatched Route'). If any lingering deep-links exist in emails/notifications, consider adding an explicit redirect from /settings/accessibility → /settings?anchor=accessibility in a +not-found handler.
